items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Control heights from --lw-control-h-*, an 18px stance, and a 2px brand focus ring — except on filled variants, which take an offset outline because a brand ring on a brand fill is 1:1 against it.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A PILL, and that is the role rather than a rounding choice. Ships the five status roles plus outline; a product composes its own states from bg-*-soft / text-*-on.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: h-control-md, radius-sm, --lw-field-pad-x, a non-inset brand ring, and a danger ring on aria-invalid.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: radius-lg, and data-slot="card" on the root — a test that selects a card by its border-radius breaks the moment the radius scale moves, which is exactly what happened once.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The system's signature header: mono, uppercase, --lw-th-text at --lw-th-tracking on a subtle ground. The single thing a hand-written table most often gets wrong.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: 38x22 with a 16px thumb at a 2px inset — the travel is (w - thumb - 2*inset), so the three values are one decision and all three are tokens.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: An underline strip, not a pill tray.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: radius-xl on a --lw-scrim backdrop with a blur.
